displayName: ElderGuard: Cloud Run startup latency p95 over 12 s

documentation.content: A cold start is nearing Twilio's 15 s webhook timeout. Fresh-host boots measure about 10 s, mostly Python library imports (see the startup_timing log). Startup CPU boost is already on. Before real users, set minScale to 1 in cloudrun.yaml so calls rarely land on a booting instance.
